svg.title: The moss editor and preview, with four landmarks
svg.desc: A harvested view of the real moss editor and preview shell, followed by detail views of the file breadcrumb, writing surface, preview controls, and publish button.
svg.text: Moss editor and preview: two captured views, four landmarks

g.text: Follow the breadcrumb to the page.
Write normally, or type / for blocks.
Check the site and its device view.
Review, then use the arrow to publish.

svg.text: Source: ui/editor.html + ui/shell.html · labels are annotations; interface pixels are harvested.
